name: floorplan
description: Declarative floor-plan renderer and linter. Text in, scaled SVG out, with findings.

scripts.examples: for f in casa-t3 apartment-t2 cabin casa-patio quinta casa-piscina broken; do node src/bin.ts fixtures/$f.json --out examples/$f.svg --mark info; done; true
scripts.build:app: npm run build && npm -w @floorplan/playground run build
scripts.dev:app: npm run build && npm -w @floorplan/playground run dev
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run build && npm -w @floorplan/playground run typecheck
